xml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<ncbi_application xmlns="ncbi:application"
 xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
 xs:schemaLocation="ncbi:application ncbi_application.xsd"
>
<program type="regular">
<name>makeblastdb</name>
<version>0.2.0</version>
<description>Application to create BLAST databases, version LOSAT 0.2.0</description>
<detailed_description></detailed_description>
</program>
<arguments>
<key name="blastdb_version" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>Version of BLAST database to be created</description>
<group>4</group>
<synopsis>version</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>4..5</description>
<Integers>
<min>4</min>
<max>5</max>
</Integers>
</constraint>
<default>5</default>
</key>
<key name="dbtype" type="String">
<description>Molecule type of target db</description>
<synopsis>molecule_type</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`nucl', `prot'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>nucl</value>
<value>prot</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="gi_mask_name" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Comma-separated list of masking data output files.</description>
<group>3</group>
<synopsis>gi_based_mask_names</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="in" type="File_In" optional="true">
<description>Input file/database name</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>input_file</synopsis>
<default>-</default>
</key>
<key name="input_type" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Type of the data specified in input_file</description>
<group>1</group>
<synopsis>type</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>`asn1_bin', `asn1_txt', `blastdb', `fasta'</description>
<Strings case_sensitive="true">
<value>asn1_bin</value>
<value>asn1_txt</value>
<value>blastdb</value>
<value>fasta</value>
</Strings>
</constraint>
<default>fasta</default>
</key>
<key name="logfile" type="File_Out" optional="true">
<description>File to which the program log should be redirected</description>
<group>4</group>
<synopsis>File_Name</synopsis>
<flags><append/></flags>
</key>
<key name="mask_data" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Comma-separated list of input files containing masking data as produced by NCBI masking applications (e.g. dustmasker, segmasker, windowmasker)</description>
<group>3</group>
<synopsis>mask_data_files</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="mask_desc" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Comma-separated list of free form strings to describe the masking algorithm details</description>
<group>3</group>
<synopsis>mask_algo_descriptions</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="mask_id" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Comma-separated list of strings to uniquely identify the masking algorithm</description>
<group>3</group>
<synopsis>mask_algo_ids</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="max_file_sz" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Maximum file size for BLAST database files</description>
<group>4</group>
<synopsis>number_of_bytes</synopsis>
<default>3GB</default>
</key>
<key name="metadata_output_prefix" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Path prefix for location of database files in metadata</description>
<group>4</group>
</key>
<key name="oid_masks" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>0x01 Exclude Model</description>
<group>5</group>
<synopsis>oid_masks</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="out" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Name of BLAST database to be created
Default = input file name provided to -in argumentRequired if multiple file(s)/database(s) are provided as input</description>
<group>4</group>
<synopsis>database_name</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="taxid" type="Integer" optional="true">
<description>Taxonomy ID to assign to all sequences</description>
<group>5</group>
<synopsis>TaxID</synopsis>
<constraint>
<description>>=0</description>
</constraint>
</key>
<key name="taxid_map" type="File_In" optional="true">
<description>Text file mapping sequence IDs to taxonomy IDs.
Format:<SequenceId> <TaxonomyId><newline></description>
<group>5</group>
<synopsis>TaxIDMapFile</synopsis>
</key>
<key name="title" type="String" optional="true">
<description>Title for BLAST database
Default = input file name provided to -in argument</description>
<group>2</group>
<synopsis>database_title</synopsis>
</key>
<flag name="gi_mask" optional="true">
<description>Create GI indexed masking data.</description>
<group>3</group>
</flag>
<flag name="h" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION;  ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="hash_index" optional="true">
<description>Create index of sequence hash values.</description>
<group>2</group>
</flag>
<flag name="help" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="help-full" optional="true">
<description>Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS, including hidden ones; ignore all other parameters</description>
</flag>
<flag name="parse_seqids" optional="true">
<description>Option to parse seqid for FASTA input if set, for all other input types seqids are parsed automatically</description>
<group>2</group>
</flag>
<flag name="randomize" optional="true">
<description>Randomize input db seqs</description>
<group>2</group>
<flags><hidden/></flags>
</flag>
<flag name="version" optional="true">
<description>Print version number;  ignore other arguments</description>
</flag>
<dependencies>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>gi_mask</arg1>
<arg2>parse_seqids</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>gi_mask_name</arg1>
<arg2>mask_data</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>gi_mask_name</arg1>
<arg2>gi_mask</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>mask_desc</arg1>
<arg2>mask_id</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>mask_id</arg1>
<arg2>mask_data</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_requires_second>
<arg1>taxid_map</arg1>
<arg2>parse_seqids</arg2>
</first_requires_second>
<first_excludes_second>
<arg1>gi_mask</arg1>
<arg2>mask_id</arg2>
</first_excludes_second>
<first_excludes_second>
<arg1>mask_id</arg1>
<arg2>gi_mask</arg2>
</first_excludes_second>
<first_excludes_second>
<arg1>taxid</arg1>
<arg2>taxid_map</arg2>
</first_excludes_second>
<first_excludes_second>
<arg1>taxid_map</arg1>
<arg2>taxid</arg2>
</first_excludes_second>
</dependencies>
</arguments>
</ncbi_application>
